sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Every action roll resolves into one of five table results: critical success, success with Hope, success with Fear, failure with Hope, or failure with Fear.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use after every Action Roll or Reaction Roll where the Hope/Fear spin matters.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Check doubles first for Critical Success.
If not a critical, compare total to Difficulty.
At or above Difficulty succeeds; below Difficulty fails.
Hope spin gives Hope and a cleaner/kinder edge; Fear spin gives the GM Fear and a cost or complication.

sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: Every action roll resolves into one of five table results: critical success, success with Hope, success with Fear, failure with Hope, or failure with Fear.
When: Use after every Action Roll or Reaction Roll where the Hope/Fear spin matters.
Not When: Do not flatten rolls into pass/fail when the spin should change cost, benefit, or GM pressure.
Question: What does my result mean?
Answer: First compare the total to Difficulty. Then read Hope, Fear, or matching dice to choose the exact result.
Example: A Presence 12 strixwolf approach that succeeds with Fear calms the mother but lets the GM add pressure from the pack or the woods.
Related: action-roll duality-dice hope fear critical-success
Aliases: result matrix roll outcomes success with fear failure with hope
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
